title: Local generic-basis subtraction criterion
statement: Let (R,m) be a local ring and R\to S a flat finitely presented homomorphism of commutative rings with geometrically integral fibres. Let q\in Spec(S) lie over m, let N be a finite S-module, and let \alpha :S^{\oplus r}\to N be S-linear. Write \xi =mS, which is prime because the fibre S\otimes_R\kappa(m) is a domain. Assume N_q is flat over R and \alpha\otimes_S\kappa(\xi):\kappa(\xi)^{\oplus r}\to N\otimes _S\kappa (\xi ) is an isomorphism. Then \alpha  is universally injective as an R-module map and (coker \alpha )_q is flat over R. Local rings, spectra, modules, flatness, finite presentation, residue fields, localizations and geometric integrality are [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], [def-weil-residue-field], [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [def-weil-pbc-module-localization], [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible].
